(function () {
  // Если DOM уже готов — стартуем сразу, иначе ждём DOMContentLoaded
  const run = () => {
    const iframe = document.getElementById('vimeo-video');
    if (!iframe || typeof Vimeo === 'undefined' || !Vimeo.Player) return;

    // Задержка: из data-атрибута или дефолт 500 мс
    const delayMs = Number(iframe.getAttribute('data-autoplay-delay')) || 500;

    const player = new Vimeo.Player(iframe);

    // Для надёжного автоплея держим звук выключенным
    player.setMuted(true).catch(() => {});

    let started = false;
    const startPlay = () => {
      if (started) return;
      started = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        player.play().catch((err) => {
          // Частый случай: блокировка автоплея браузером

    };

    player.on('loaded', startPlay);

    // Fallback: если событие вдруг не пришло за разумное время
    setTimeout(startPlay, 1500);
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run, { once: true });
  } else {
    run();

<script>

const TOGGLE_COOLDOWN_MS = 500;

let lenis = new Lenis({
  lerp: 0.1,
  wheelMultiplier: 0.7,
  gestureOrientation: "vertical",
  normalizeWheel: false,
  smoothTouch: false,
});

let modalLenis = null;      
let __modalOpen = false;    
let __lastToggleTs = 0;     


function raf(time) {
  try { lenis.raf(time); } catch(_) {}
  if (modalLenis) {
    try { modalLenis.raf(time); } catch(_) {}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(raf);
}
requestAnimationFrame(raf);


function updateScrollbarCompensation() {
  const sbw = window.innerWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth;
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--sbw", sbw + "px");
}
updateScrollbarCompensation();
window.addEventListener("resize", updateScrollbarCompensation);


function setModalOpenState(on) {
  __modalOpen = !!on;
  updateScrollbarCompensation();
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle("is-modal-open", __modalOpen);
  document.body.classList.toggle("is-modal-open", __modalOpen);
  syncToggleButtons(__modalOpen);
}


function syncToggleButtons(isOpen) {
  const $all = $("[data-lenis-toggle]");
  if (isOpen) $all.addClass("stop-scroll"); else $all.removeClass("stop-scroll");
}


$("[data-lenis-start]").on("click", function () {
  forceCloseModalAndResumeScroll(); 
});

$("[data-lenis-stop]").on("click", function () {
  openModalSmoothScroll();
  try { lenis.stop(); } catch(_) {}
});


$(document).on("pointerup", "[data-lenis-toggle]", function (e) {
  if (e.pointerType === "touch" || e.pointerType === "pen") e.preventDefault();


  if (e.target.closest(".menu_button_wrap")) return;

  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - __lastToggleTs < TOGGLE_COOLDOWN_MS) {

    return;
  }
  __lastToggleTs = now;

  if (!__modalOpen) {
   
    openModalSmoothScroll();
    try { lenis.stop(); } catch(_) {}
  } else {
   
    closeModalSmoothScroll();
    try { lenis.start(); } catch(_) {}
  }
});


function openModalSmoothScroll() {
  if (modalLenis) return;

  const wrapper = document.querySelector(".awards-full_right");
  if (!wrapper) {
    
    setModalOpenState(true);
    return;
  }

  
  setModalOpenState(true);

  const content =
    wrapper.querySelector(".awards-full_right-content") || wrapper.firstElementChild;

  wrapper.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
  wrapper.focus();

  modalLenis = new Lenis({
    wrapper,
    content,
    lerp: 0.12,
    wheelMultiplier: 0.8,
    gestureOrientation: "vertical",
    smoothWheel: true,
    smoothTouch: true,
    normalizeWheel: false,
  });

  wrapper.addEventListener("wheel", stopProp, { passive: false });
  wrapper.addEventListener("touchmove", stopProp, { passive: false });
  wrapper.addEventListener("keydown", trapScrollKeys, { passive: false });
}

function closeModalSmoothScroll() {
  const wrapper = document.querySelector(".awards-full_right");

  if (wrapper) {
    wrapper.removeEventListener("wheel", stopProp, { passive: false });
    wrapper.removeEventListener("touchmove", stopProp, { passive: false });
    wrapper.removeEventListener("keydown", trapScrollKeys, { passive: false });
  }

  if (modalLenis) {
    try { modalLenis.destroy(); } catch(_) {}
    modalLenis = null;
  }

  
  setModalOpenState(false);

  
  ensureScrollResumed();

  
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh(true);
  });
}


function ensureScrollResumed() {
  
  if (!__modalOpen) {
    try { lenis.start(); } catch (_) {}
    
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("is-modal-open");
    document.body.classList.remove("is-modal-open");
    syncToggleButtons(false);
  }
}


window.addEventListener("pageshow", ensureScrollResumed);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
  if (document.visibilityState === "visible") ensureScrollResumed();
});


function stopProp(e) { e.stopPropagation(); }
function trapScrollKeys(e) {
  const keys = ["Space","PageUp","PageDown","Home","End","ArrowUp","ArrowDown"];
  if (keys.includes(e.code)) {
    const inside = e.target.closest(".awards-full_right");
    if (!inside) e.preventDefault();
  }
}


function forceCloseModalAndResumeScroll() {
  if (__modalOpen || modalLenis) {
    closeModalSmoothScroll();
  }
  ensureScrollResumed();
}


(function setupMobileMenuVisibilityLock() {
  const MENU_SELECTOR  = ".mobile-menu";
  const BTN_SELECTOR   = ".menu_button_wrap";

  const menuEl  = document.querySelector(MENU_SELECTOR);
  const btnList = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(BTN_SELECTOR));

  if (!menuEl || !btnList.length) return; 


  let __lastMenuClickTs = 0;

  
  function isVisible(el) {
    if (!el) return false;
    const style = getComputedStyle(el);
    if (style.display === "none") return false;
    if (style.visibility === "hidden") return false;

   
    const aria = el.getAttribute("aria-hidden");
    if (aria === "true") return false;

    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return false;



    return true;
  }


  let lastState = isVisible(menuEl);

  function syncLockWithMenu(forceCheck = false) {
    const visible = forceCheck ? isVisible(menuEl) : isVisible(menuEl);
    if (visible === lastState) return;
    lastState = visible;

    if (visible) {

      if (!__modalOpen) {
        setModalOpenState(true);
        try { lenis.stop(); } catch(_) {}
      }
    } else {

      if (__modalOpen) {
        setModalOpenState(false);
        ensureScrollResumed();
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh(true);
        });
      } else {
        ensureScrollResumed();
      }
    }
  }


  const mo = new MutationObserver(() => syncLockWithMenu(true));
  mo.observe(menuEl, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ["class", "style", "aria-hidden"]
  });

 
  function schedulePostClickChecks() {
    
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        syncLockWithMenu(true);
        setTimeout(() => syncLockWithMenu(true), 350);
      });
    });
  }

  
  btnList.forEach((btn) => {
    btn.addEventListener("pointerup", (e) => {
      if (e.pointerType === "touch" || e.pointerType === "pen") e.preventDefault();

      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - __lastMenuClickTs < TOGGLE_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
      __lastMenuClickTs = now;


      schedulePostClickChecks();
    }, { passive: false });
  });


  syncLockWithMenu(true);


  window.addEventListener("pageshow", () => syncLockWithMenu(true));
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") syncLockWithMenu(true);
  });
})();
</script>



<script>
  (function () {
    const TARGETS = [
      ".local-time",
      ".footer-local-time",
    ];

    function normalizeTimeStr(s) {

      return String(s).replace(/[\u00A0\u202F]/g, " ");
    }


    function mapTimeRange(chars) {
      const text = Array.from(chars).map(ch => ch.textContent).join("");

      const m = text.match(/\d{2}:\d{2}\s[AP]M/);
      if (!m) return null;


      let start = -1, end = -1, acc = 0;
      const targetStart = m.index;
      const targetEnd = m.index + m[0].length - 1; 

      for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
        const len = (chars[i].textContent || "").length;
        const charStart = acc;
        const charEnd = acc + Math.max(1, len) - 1; 
        if (start < 0 && charStart <= targetStart && targetStart <= charEnd) {
          start = i;
        }
        if (charStart <= targetEnd && targetEnd <= charEnd) {
          end = i;
          break;
        }
        acc += Math.max(1, len);
      }

      if (start >= 0 && end >= start) return { start, end };
      return null;
    }

 
    const timeIndexCache = new WeakMap();

    function getOrMakeTimeIndex(el) {
      if (timeIndexCache.has(el)) return timeIndexCache.get(el);

      const chars = el.querySelectorAll(".char");
      if (!chars.length) {
        timeIndexCache.set(el, null);
        return null;
      }

      const idx = mapTimeRange(chars);
      timeIndexCache.set(el, idx);
      return idx;
    }

    function renderYerevanTime() {
      const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone: "Asia/Yerevan",
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
        hour12: true
      });

    
      const timeStr = normalizeTimeStr(formatter.format(new Date()));
      const timeArr = timeStr.split(""); // ['0','2',':','1','4',' ','P','M']

      TARGETS.forEach(sel => {
        document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
          const chars = el.querySelectorAll(".char");

          if (!chars.length) {

            el.textContent = timeStr;
            return;
          }

          const idx = getOrMakeTimeIndex(el);

          if (!idx) {


            return;
          }

          const { start, end } = idx;
          const spanLen = end - start + 1;


          const wanted = timeArr.slice(0, spanLen);
          while (wanted.length < spanLen) wanted.push(" ");

          for (let k = 0; k < spanLen; k++) {
            const ch = chars[start + k];
            const val = wanted[k];
            
            if (ch.textContent !== val) ch.textContent = val;
            ch.setAttribute("letter", val);
          }
        });
      });
    }

    function tickEveryMinuteAligned(fn) {
      fn(); 
      const now = new Date();
      const msToNextMinute =
        (60 - now.getSeconds()) * 1000 - now.getMilliseconds();
      setTimeout(function start() {
        fn();
        setInterval(fn, 60_000);
      }, Math.max(0, msToNextMinute));
    }


    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      TARGETS.forEach(sel => {
        document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el => {
          timeIndexCache.delete(el); 
          getOrMakeTimeIndex(el);   
        });
      });

      renderYerevanTime();
    }, { once: true });

    tickEveryMinuteAligned(renderYerevanTime);
  })();
</script>


<script>

let transitionTrigger = $(".transition-trigger");
let introDurationMS = 200;
let exitDurationMS = 1400;
let excludedClass = "no-transition";


(function () {
  const supportsBackdrop =
    typeof CSS !== "undefined" &&
    (CSS.supports("backdrop-filter", "blur(10px)") ||
     CSS.supports("-webkit-backdrop-filter", "blur(10px)"));

  function getEl() {
    return document.querySelector(".transition-blur");
  }

  function setBlurImmediate(px) {
    const el = getEl();
    if (!el) return;
    if (supportsBackdrop) {
      el.style.backdropFilter = `blur(${px}px)`;
      el.style.webkitBackdropFilter = `blur(${px}px)`;
    } else {
      el.style.filter = `blur(${px}px)`;
    }
  }

  function animateBlurTo(px, durationMs, easing) {
    const el = getEl();
    if (!el) return;
    const prevTransition = el.style.transition || "";
    const durS = (durationMs / 800) + "s";

   
    el.style.transition =
      (prevTransition ? prevTransition + ", " : "") +
      `backdrop-filter ${durS} ${easing}, -webkit-backdrop-filter ${durS} ${easing}, filter ${durS} ${easing}`;

  
    void el.offsetWidth;

    if (supportsBackdrop) {
      el.style.backdropFilter = `blur(${px}px)`;
      el.style.webkitBackdropFilter = `blur(${px}px)`;
    } else {
      el.style.filter = `blur(${px}px)`;
    }

   
    setTimeout(() => { el.style.transition = prevTransition; }, durationMs + 60);
  }

  window.__transitionBlur = {
    set: setBlurImmediate,
    animateTo: animateBlurTo,
  };
})();


window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  if (transitionTrigger.length > 0) {
    
    Webflow.push(function () {
      transitionTrigger.click();
    });

    
    if (window.__transitionBlur) {
      window.__transitionBlur.set(0);
    }
  }
});


$("a").on("click", function (e) {
  if (
    $(this).prop("hostname") == window.location.host &&
    $(this).attr("href").indexOf("#") === -1 &&
    !$(this).hasClass(excludedClass) &&
    $(this).attr("target") !== "_blank" &&
    transitionTrigger.length > 0
  ) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const transitionURL = $(this).attr("href");


    if (window.__transitionBlur) {
      window.__transitionBlur.set(0);
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.__transitionBlur.animateTo(
          10,
          1000,
          "cubic-bezier(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1.000)" 
        );
      }, 300);
    }

    transitionTrigger.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      window.location = transitionURL;
    }, exitDurationMS);
  }
});


window.onpageshow = function (event) {
  if (event.persisted) {
    window.location.reload();
  }
};


setTimeout(() => {
  $(window).on("resize", function () {
    setTimeout(() => { $(".transition").css("display", "none"); }, 50);
  });
}, introDurationMS);
</script>



<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const selectors = ['.portfolio-project-preview_video', '.small-preview_video', '.preview-video'];
  const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll(selectors.join(','));

  wrappers.forEach((wrap) => {
    
    const vid = wrap.querySelector('video');
    if (!vid) return;

    const applyRatio = () => {
      const vw = vid.videoWidth;
      const vh = vid.videoHeight;
      if (!vw || !vh) return;

      
      wrap.style.aspectRatio = `${vw} / ${vh}`;
      wrap.style.height = 'auto';

     
      if (!CSS.supports('aspect-ratio', '1/1')) {
        const updateHeight = () => {
          const width = wrap.getBoundingClientRect().width;
          wrap.style.height = (width * vh / vw) + 'px';
        };
        updateHeight();

        
        if ('ResizeObserver' in window) {
          const ro = new ResizeObserver(updateHeight);
          ro.observe(wrap);
        } else {
          window.addEventListener('resize', debounce(updateHeight, 150));
        }
      }

      
      Object.assign(vid.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        inset: '0',
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        objectFit: vid.style.objectFit || 'cover'
      });
    };

    if (vid.readyState >= 1) {
      
      applyRatio();
    } else {
      
      vid.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', applyRatio, { once: true });
    }
  });

  function debounce(fn, wait) {
    let t;
    return (...args) => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      t = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), wait);
    };
  }
});
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const frameA = "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/680370eb38ccbea9790c27e5/68b83b5811d02ef72f628156_1.png";
  const frameB = "https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/680370eb38ccbea9790c27e5/68b83b58b673119cd0465702_1-1.png";
  const frames = [frameA, frameB];
  const intervalMs = 900;

  
  frames.forEach(src => { const im = new Image(); im.src = src; });

 
  let idx = 0, timer = null;
  const startedAt = Date.now();

  function setIcon(href) {
    const head = document.head;
    head.querySelectorAll('link[rel="icon"], link[rel="shortcut icon"]').forEach(n => n.remove());

    
    const l1 = document.createElement("link");
    l1.rel = "icon";
    l1.type = "image/png";
    l1.href = href; 
    head.appendChild(l1);

    const l2 = document.createElement("link");
    l2.rel = "shortcut icon";
    l2.type = "image/png";
    l2.href = l1.href;
    head.appendChild(l2);
  }

  function tick() {
    idx = 1 - idx;                 
    setIcon(frames[idx]);
  }

  function start() {
    if (timer) return;

    const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
    idx = Math.floor(elapsed / intervalMs) % frames.length;
    setIcon(frames[idx]);
    timer = setInterval(tick, intervalMs);
  }

  function stop() {
    if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; }
  }

  
  start();

  
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAt;
      idx = Math.floor(elapsed / intervalMs) % frames.length;
      setIcon(frames[idx]);
      if (!timer) start();
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  
  const bgVideos = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.w-background-video > video, .w-background-video-elem'));

  
  bgVideos.forEach(v => {
    try {
      v.muted = true;
      v.setAttribute('muted', '');
      v.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
      v.setAttribute('loop', '');
      
      if (v.readyState < 2) {
        v.load();
      }
      
      v.currentTime = Math.max(0.01, v.currentTime || 0);
    } catch (_) {}
  });

  
  const needGesture = new Set();

  const tryPlay = (v) => {
    if (!v) return;
    const p = v.play && v.play();
    if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') {
      p.catch(() => {
        
        needGesture.add(v);
      });
    }
  };

  const tryPause = (v) => {
    if (!v) return;
    if (!v.paused) v.pause();
  };

  
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(({ target, isIntersecting }) => {
      if (isIntersecting) {
        
        if (target.readyState < 2) target.load();
        if (target.currentTime === 0) {
          try { target.currentTime = 0.01; } catch(_) {}
        }
        tryPlay(target);
      } else {
        tryPause(target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.25 });

  bgVideos.forEach(v => io.observe(v));

  
  const userKick = () => {
    needGesture.forEach(v => {
      
      try { if (v.readyState < 2) v.load(); } catch(_) {}
      try { if (v.currentTime === 0) v.currentTime = 0.01; } catch(_) {}
      const p = v.play && v.play();
      if (p && typeof p.then === 'function') {
        p.then(() => needGesture.delete(v)).catch(() => {});
      }
    });
    document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', userKick);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', userKick);
  };
  document.addEventListener('pointerdown', userKick, { once: true, passive: true });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', userKick, { once: true });

  
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.hidden) {
      bgVideos.forEach(tryPause);
    } else {
     
      bgVideos.forEach(v => {
        const r = v.getBoundingClientRect();
        const inView = r.bottom > 0 && r.right > 0 && r.top < (window.innerHeight || 0) && r.left < (window.innerWidth || 0);
        if (inView) tryPlay(v);
      });
    }
  });

 
});
